The supplier can quit the contract with 60 days' notice whenever it likes — but you've already paid big fees upfront, and nothing in the contract says you get that money back. They could walk away with your cash and you'd have no refund right.

For example

You pay a builder the full price in advance, and the contract lets him quit the job whenever he wants — pocketing your money with no obligation to return it.
